SetDetectionMode.description: The Method SetDetectionMode enables or disables the defect reason.

Enable.description: Specifies if the method enables or disables the defect reason

ExecutionFeedback.title: MethodExecutionFeedbackType
ExecutionFeedback.description: The MethodExecutionFeedbackType provides suitable feedback, both positive and negative, to an OPC UA client invoking a method.

Success.description: Returns True in case of successful execution.

Message.description: Array of detailed messages describing the reason for the unsuccessful execution or notice to the user.

items.title: MessageType
items.description: The MessageType provides a uniquely identified localised text.

ID.description: Unique identifier for the localised text.

DetectionCountMasterTotal.description: The total number of times the defect reason occurred. The total is never reset to zero.

DetectionCountTotal.description: The total number of times a defect reason occurred. The total is reset to zero only when the  ResetProductionTotals method in the MachineModuleProductionType is executed successfully.

DetectionMode.description: When DetectionMode is True, the defect reason is triggered. When DetectionMode is False, the  defect reason is not active, i.e. never triggered.

data.description: The total number of times the defect reason occurred. The total is never reset to zero.
